_howto: Officers, appointed directors, and any manual additions to imadalisyed.com/club.
You normally do NOT edit this file for ordinary members. Verified signups come from the
response sheet: type 'y' in the 'Approved (y)' column and the name appears on the site
within about five minutes, no commit needed.
Use this file for: people who never filled in the form, and anyone whose displayed role
should override what the sheet says. A name here wins over the same name from the sheet,
which is how a director keeps their title even though the sheet lists them as 'Member'.
ROLES DRIVE EVERYTHING. Change the role string and the site updates:
President / Vice President / Secretary / Treasurer
-> purple badge on the member wall. (The Executive board cards are hard-coded in
club.html, so update those too if an officer changes.)
Director of Events & Operations / Director of Marketing & Communications /
Director of Programs / Community Manager / CTF Team Lead / Workshop Lead / Events Lead
-> cyan badge, AND the person appears in the 'Core team' section of the page.
Anything else -> grey badge, member wall only.
A promotion is a one-line edit here plus a push. To add a brand new role title, add it to
the LEADS array in club.html as well or it won't show in the Core team section.
Fields: name (required), role (required), joined (optional ISO date, e.g. 2026-05-08),
founding (optional true), note (optional, small grey line under the name on the Core
team card). Leave 'joined' out and the page prints 'founding officer' instead of a date.
Never put EMPLIDs or email addresses in this file - it is public.
